mechanism.description: Each stage is dispatched only when (a) its static dependencies are PASS, (b) its declarative extra_gate in changes.json evaluates true against verifiable evidence, and (c) a traceable authorization for that specific stage exists with actor, scope and date. A technical PASS never implies execution permission.

governance_attribution_note.observation: All fifteen records in this directory carry change_id 'sc-02-runtime-readiness', which is BLOCKED with approved_for_implementation: false. The synthesis is in substance the deliverable of sc-06-scientific-synthesis, also BLOCKED, and docs/research/scientific-closure-synthesis-2026-09-20.md is not listed in the paths of any change.
governance_attribution_note.response: The observation is correct and is not disputed. What this session did NOT do: it did not transition any change out of BLOCKED, did not fabricate a state_event, did not set approved_for_implementation, and did not close any change. changes.json is byte-unchanged, which the evidence checker verified independently. What it DID do: produce readiness evidence and documentation under the repository owner's standing instruction (AUTH-PREP-2026-09-20), which authorises exactly that. The change_id field on these records names the SCOPE the evidence belongs to, not a claim that the change was dispatched. The synthesis is a session deliverable that documents an unexecuted protocol; it is NOT the sc-06 deliverable, because sc-06's acceptance requires an audited terminal A/B/C stage that does not exist.
governance_attribution_note.residual_irregularity: Under a strict reading of operations.md, evidence for a change should be produced after that change is APPROVED. Here the evidence was produced first, precisely because it is the evidence needed to decide whether sc-02 can leave BLOCKED. That ordering is recorded as an irregularity rather than defended as correct, and it is for the auditor to judge. It did not relax any gate: sc-02 remains BLOCKED and G1 remains NOT_SATISFIED.
governance_attribution_note.path_declaration: docs/research/scientific-closure-synthesis-2026-09-20.md and this whole directory are outside the declared paths of every change. They are declared here instead of being silently attached to a change's path list.
